source.label: The Bally Game Show rules and strategy

strategy.overview: Light the TV, TRUCK, TRIP, and CAR prizes by completing their targets, then shoot the far-right Collect ramp hard enough to reach the left Collect saucer. With all four prizes lit, that same ramp-and-saucer shot starts two-ball Showcase Bonanza. Return there during Multiball to collect the falling Grand Prize value.
strategy.simpleOverview: Complete the TV, TRUCK, TRIP, and CAR targets to light all four prizes. Then shoot the far-right Collect ramp hard enough to reach the left Collect saucer and start two-ball Showcase Bonanza. During Multiball, make that same full ramp shot to collect the Grand Prize before it falls to one million.
strategy.summary: Light TV, TRUCK, TRIP, and CAR, then make the far-right Collect ramp all the way to the left saucer for two-ball Showcase Bonanza. Repeat that full shot during Multiball to collect the falling Grand Prize.

quickInfo.name: Light Prizes
quickInfo.summary: Complete TV, TRUCK, TRIP, and the CAR drop; the rear SPOT loop can help fill letters.

quickInfo.name: Start Multiball
quickInfo.summary: With all four prizes lit, shoot the far-right Collect ramp into the left saucer.

quickInfo.name: Collect Grand Prize
quickInfo.summary: During Multiball, repeat the full Collect ramp-and-saucer shot.

quickInfo.name: Play Big Bucks
quickInfo.summary: Hit the CAR drop to expose the Big Bucks hole, then build and cash its award.

steps.text: Complete T-V, T-R-U-C-K, T-R-I-P, and the CAR drop target to light all four prizes.
Use the rear SPOT loop when available to fill missing prize letters.
Shoot the far-right Collect ramp with enough speed to reach the left Collect saucer and start two-ball Showcase Bonanza.
During Multiball, repeat the full Collect ramp-and-saucer shot to take the falling Grand Prize value.

alternatives.title: Build Big Bucks
alternatives.when: Use this when the CAR drop and center return are safer than the long Collect ramp.

steps.text: Hit the CAR drop to expose the Big Bucks hole.
Shoot Big Bucks repeatedly to build and cash its award, up to one million.
Roll through the right inlane to light SPIN at the Wheel ramp.
Shoot the Wheel ramp and complete the full loop for the current award.
After one full loop, use well-timed nudges to continue looping the ball for additional awards.

machineSetup: Confirm the Grand Prize timer and extra-ball settings before competitive play.
Test all prize targets, rear SPOT loop, far-right Collect ramp, left Collect saucer, CAR drop and Big Bucks hole, Wheel ramp, and trough.

cautions.issue: Collect Ramp shots that do not reach the left saucer do not finish the required collection.
cautions.response: Favor a clean, full-strength ramp shot; do not count a partial climb as the Multiball start or Grand Prize collect.
